usual_baseline: DNA rates vary: 7.5% [3397], 29% [3444], 35.3% in perinatal care [3460]. Letters go out (98.1%) but follow-up is weak. Risk assessment after a DNA 48.2–50.9%, updated in 25% [3287][3586]. After a DNA no contact in 57% [3444]. Risk plans 49.4% [3586].
fix_that_works: SMS reminders one working day before appointments cut the mean DNA rate from 7.5% to 5.0% [3397]. Staff awareness of the trust guideline raised risk documentation after DNA from 48.2% to 95% and repeat appointments offered from 77.6% to 92% [3586].
fix_that_fails: In the same audit risk management plans rose only from 49.4% to 58% and MDT notification from 50.5% to 60%. Contacting patients after DNA fell from 81.1% to 74% and confirming appointments from 94.1% to 92% [3586].
consultant_advice: Few audits and only two closed loops, so there is room here. Awareness fixes the risk entry but not the plan. Audit what happens after a DNA for high-risk patients, welfare checks and family contact [3287], and test reminders or home and remote options, as DNA was lower away from the centre [3460].
